subject: literacy
concept: Comparing how two speakers/authors use different rhetorical strategies to address the same issue
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts rhetorical strategies from two speeches on the same issue into a comparison chart
exercise.pictorial: Student matches each speaker's dominant appeal (ethos, pathos, logos) to their overall approach
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph comparing the rhetorical strategies of two texts addressing the same issue

assessment.mastery_threshold: comparison identifies genuinely different rhetorical strategies with specific textual support from both
misconception_flags: describes both texts' content without actually comparing their rhetorical strategies

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
